page.overview:
Who is B.A.T.?

Battle Assault Troopers or B.A.T.s for short are the main mechanized infantry units and nearly the entire attack force of Cobra throughout most of the Sigma 6 animated series.

Within the majority of the Sigma 6 series the B.A.T.s appear to be the sole ground trooper of Cobra while human troops appeared to only be an 2ndary role seeming to control and coordinate them remotely from Cobras various bases.
